en.topic_title: Hong Kong judge who committed serial plagiarism to take early retirement at chief justice’s request
en.topic_summary:
A High Court judge will retire early this week after he was found to have committed plagiarism in his judgements at least five times over the past three years.



High Court Judge Wilson Chan. Photo: Judiciary. 



High Court Judge Wilson Chan tendered his retirement at the request of Chief Justice Andrew Cheung. It will come into effect on Friday, the judiciary said on Monday.
